name: quiz-royale
description: Quiz Royale — Real-Time Multiplayer Trivia Battle

scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.env.RENDER){require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm run build', {stdio: 'inherit'})}"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:render: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm run build
